name: Mysuru
overview: A cultural city known for its palace, markets and living craft traditions.

attractions.name: Mysore Palace
attractions.description: Explore the historic royal palace and its architecture.
attractions.notes: Check the official venue for current visitor arrangements and timings.

attractions.name: Devaraja Market
attractions.description: Walk through a busy market of produce, flowers and local goods.
attractions.notes: Go with a local guide if you want help understanding the market.

attractions.name: Chamundi Hill
attractions.description: Visit the hilltop temple area and take in views over the city.
attractions.notes: Plan for steps and check local access conditions.

attractions.name: Karanji Lake Nature Park
attractions.description: A city nature stop for a relaxed walk and birdwatching.
attractions.notes: Verify opening status before travel.

practical_notes: Mysuru works well as a base for cultural sightseeing. Confirm venue schedules and local transport before departure.

name: Hampi
overview: A large archaeological landscape of temple remains, boulder hills and village settlements.

attractions.name: Virupaksha Temple area
attractions.description: Explore the active temple and historic bazaar landscape.
attractions.notes: Dress respectfully and check current visitor guidance.

attractions.name: Vijaya Vittala Temple complex
attractions.description: See a major monument complex in the Hampi heritage landscape.
attractions.notes: Allow time for walking; access arrangements can change.

attractions.name: Hemakuta Hill
attractions.description: A boulder hill with temple remains and broad landscape views.
attractions.notes: Avoid exposed midday walking in hot weather.

attractions.name: Hampi riverside and bazaar walk
attractions.description: A flexible walk through the settlement and riverside area.
attractions.notes: Check river crossing and local access conditions on the day.

practical_notes: The monuments are spread across a wide area. Build in walking breaks, sun protection and local transport time.

name: Coorg (Kodagu)
overview: A hill district with coffee landscapes, forest edges and Kodava cultural traditions.

attractions.name: Madikeri Fort and town
attractions.description: A compact town visit around the fort area and local streets.
attractions.notes: Check access to individual buildings locally.

attractions.name: Raja’s Seat area
attractions.description: A popular viewpoint and garden area in Madikeri.
attractions.notes: Visibility depends on weather; verify local access.

attractions.name: Coffee estate visit
attractions.description: Learn about coffee cultivation on a locally hosted estate visit.
attractions.notes: Arrange directly with an operating estate; visits are not guaranteed walk-ins.

attractions.name: Abbey Falls area
attractions.description: A forested waterfall stop reached by a walk from the access area.
attractions.notes: Water conditions and access vary by season.

practical_notes: Scenic stops are spread out; a car or locally arranged transport is often practical. Rain can affect road and trail conditions.

name: Chikkamagaluru
overview: A coffee-growing hill region with forested slopes and outdoor viewpoints.

attractions.name: Mullayanagiri
attractions.description: A high hill viewpoint reached by road and a short uphill walk.
attractions.notes: Weather, access and vehicle restrictions may change; confirm locally.

attractions.name: Baba Budangiri area
attractions.description: A hill landscape with religious significance and viewpoints.
attractions.notes: Check current road and access conditions.

attractions.name: Coffee estate experience
attractions.description: Explore coffee-growing landscapes through an arranged local visit.
attractions.notes: Book with an operating estate in advance.

attractions.name: Hirekolale Lake
attractions.description: A relaxed lakeside stop outside town.
attractions.notes: Facilities and access are limited; leave no litter.

practical_notes: Hill weather can change quickly. Keep plans flexible and verify road access before setting out.

name: Gokarna
overview: A coastal town combining a pilgrimage centre with beaches and walking trails.

attractions.name: Mahabaleshwar Temple area
attractions.description: Visit the town’s important temple area and surrounding streets.
attractions.notes: Observe local customs and dress guidance.

attractions.name: Kudle Beach
attractions.description: A beach stop suited to a coastal walk and sunset viewing.
attractions.notes: Sea conditions vary; swimming safety is not assured.

attractions.name: Om Beach
attractions.description: A scenic cove and coastal stop near town.
attractions.notes: Check sea and trail conditions. Avoid swimming in rough water.

attractions.name: Gokarna town walk
attractions.description: Explore the town’s temple streets and local food spots.
attractions.notes: Respect worship spaces and ask before photographing people.

practical_notes: Beach trails can be steep and exposed. Check monsoon conditions, tides and local safety advice.

name: Badami
overview: A historic town known for rock-cut cave temples and sandstone landscapes.

attractions.name: Badami Cave Temples
attractions.description: Visit rock-cut cave monuments overlooking the town and Agastya Lake.
attractions.notes: Expect steps and check current monument entry information.

attractions.name: Agastya Lake and Bhutanatha temples
attractions.description: Walk around the lakefront and temple setting.
attractions.notes: Take care near water and on uneven stone surfaces.

attractions.name: Badami Fort area
attractions.description: Explore the hill fort area and its views over the town.
attractions.notes: The climb can be strenuous in heat.

practical_notes: Combine with nearby heritage towns only when you have enough travel time; road distances are not modeled here.

name: Bengaluru
overview: A major city with parks, food neighbourhoods, museums and a layered urban history.

attractions.name: Bengaluru Palace area
attractions.description: Visit the palace grounds and learn about the city’s royal history.
attractions.notes: Confirm current entry rules and schedules.

attractions.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
attractions.description: Walk through a historic botanical garden and its plant collections.
attractions.notes: Check current access information before visiting.

attractions.name: Cubbon Park and civic district
attractions.description: A green walk through the central civic district.
attractions.notes: Some nearby institutions have separate opening schedules.

attractions.name: Local food neighbourhood walk
attractions.description: Sample regional dishes at locally chosen eateries.
attractions.notes: Specific vendors and hours are not verified; check on the day.

practical_notes: Traffic can significantly change journey times. Use current maps and transit information for local transfers.

name: Udupi
overview: A coastal district associated with temple heritage, regional vegetarian cuisine and nearby beaches.

attractions.name: Sri Krishna Matha area
attractions.description: Visit the temple district and its surrounding food streets.
attractions.notes: Follow temple visitor guidance and local customs.

attractions.name: Malpe Beach
attractions.description: A coastal outing near Udupi town.
attractions.notes: Water safety and boat services depend on conditions; confirm locally.

attractions.name: St. Mary’s Islands
attractions.description: A coastal island visit when transport services and conditions permit.
attractions.notes: Boat operations are seasonal and weather dependent; verify before planning.

attractions.name: Udupi local cuisine experience
attractions.description: Try regional dishes at a locally selected restaurant.
attractions.notes: Ask about ingredients and dietary needs directly.

practical_notes: Island access is not guaranteed and can be suspended. Have a mainland alternative.

name: Shivamogga & Jog Falls
overview: A green Malnad region and gateway to the Sharavathi river landscape and Jog Falls.

attractions.name: Jog Falls viewpoints
attractions.description: View the Sharavathi river waterfall landscape from designated viewpoints.
attractions.notes: Flow and access vary by season; check local advisories.

attractions.name: Tyavarekoppa Lion and Tiger Safari
attractions.description: A managed safari experience near Shivamogga, subject to operation.
attractions.notes: Confirm operation, booking and visitor rules with the venue.

attractions.name: Sakrebailu Elephant Camp area
attractions.description: A local wildlife-related visit where public access is available.
attractions.notes: Verify current operating status and animal welfare policies before visiting.

attractions.name: Shivamogga town food stop
attractions.description: Try regional Malnad food at a locally recommended eatery.
attractions.notes: Specific venues and hours are not verified.

practical_notes: Jog Falls is seasonal and viewpoints may close for safety. Check official local notices before travel.

name: Belur & Halebidu
overview: Two historic temple towns celebrated for Hoysala-era architecture and sculpture.

attractions.name: Chennakeshava Temple, Belur
attractions.description: Explore a major Hoysala temple known for detailed stone sculpture.
attractions.notes: Respect active worship and check monument visitor rules.

attractions.name: Hoysaleswara Temple, Halebidu
attractions.description: Visit a richly carved temple complex in Halebidu.
attractions.notes: Allow time to observe the exterior sculpture; check current access.

attractions.name: Belur town and local craft walk
attractions.description: Take a relaxed walk and look for locally made crafts and food.
attractions.notes: Ask before photographing residents or workshops.

practical_notes: Belur and Halebidu are separate stops. We do not calculate intercity drive times; plan transfers with current maps.
